data.content:
{
 "component": "camera-capture",
 "file": "kit/camera-capture.js",
 "about": "Five reasons a page asks for one photo, each with its own camera, frame and consent words, and one that needs no consent at all.",
 "cases": [
  {
   "id": "kyc",
   "label": "ID card for an account",
   "title": "Photograph your ID card",
   "hint": "Lay it flat, fill the frame, no glare.",
   "facing": "environment",
   "guide": "card",
   "consent": "I agree that a photo of my ID card is kept with my account to confirm who I am."
  },
  {
   "id": "claim",
   "label": "Damage for an insurance claim",
   "title": "Photograph the damage",
   "hint": "Step back so the whole panel is in view.",
   "facing": "environment",
   "consent": "The owner of the vehicle agrees that it is photographed for this claim.",
   "who": true
  },
  {
   "id": "title",
   "label": "Land title page",
   "title": "Photograph the land title",
   "hint": "The whole page, straight on, every corner in view.",
   "facing": "environment",
   "guide": "page",
   "consent": "The owner of this document agrees that it is photographed for the tenancy file.",
   "who": true
  },
  {
   "id": "release",
   "label": "Photo release at an event",
   "title": "A photo of you",
   "hint": "Face the camera in good light.",
   "facing": "user",
   "consent": "I agree that this photo of me may be used in the event's newsletter.",
   "who": true
  },
  {
   "id": "meter",
   "label": "Meter reading",
   "title": "Photograph the meter",
   "hint": "The dial and the serial number, both readable.",
   "facing": "environment"
  }
 ]
}

entry.name: Camera capture with consent
entry.summary: Take one photo after a recorded consent: live camera with a card or page frame, front and back switch, retake, the file picker as fallback, and a consent record with the photo.
